source: verified live on 2026-09-18: each official or fred_oecd_10y entry returned a dated observation to python/refresh_rates.py before it was recorded here
notes: Tiers: official (issuer or central bank, machine-readable) > fred_oecd_10y (OECD monthly 10y via FRED; the 7y is taken from the 10y and recorded as a substitution) > manual (hand-copied; the 45-day gate forces the refresh).
Aggregators (worldgovernmentbonds, tradingeconomics) are never a programmatic source; they are where a human reads a manual entry from.
A failed fetch writes nothing; the existing entry stays and ages out.
Constant-maturity Treasury yields, daily; the latest observation whose value is not ".".

Canada.source: Bank of Canada Valet, Government of Canada benchmark bond yields
notes: Keyless JSON. No 1y benchmark bond; the curve carries 3y to 10y.

Germany.source: Deutsche Bundesbank, listed Federal securities term structure (Svensson), daily
notes: Semicolon CSV with a decimal comma; one request per tenor.

Netherlands.source: ECB Data Portal, euro-area AAA-rated government bond spot curve (euro_area_aaa_proxy)
notes: The euro-area AAA curve stands in for AAA members only; never applied to Italy, Spain or France, whose spreads are the point.

Japan.source: Japan Ministry of Finance, JGB market yields, daily
notes: Current-month CSV; the last dated row is the latest observation.

Brazil.source: Tesouro Nacional, Tesouro Direto daily prices and yields (Tesouro Prefixado and Prefixado com Juros Semestrais)
notes: Every tenor is linearly interpolated between the two fixed-rate bonds whose maturities bracket it, on the mid of the morning buy and sell yields, and is therefore marked estimated.
The BCB SGS swap series 7805-7810 stopped in 2019; SGS carries no sovereign spot curve.

British Virgin Islands.source: U.S. Treasury curve via FRED as a proxy: no sovereign curve of its own

South Korea.source: OECD long-term government bond yield (10y, monthly average) via FRED, series IRLTLT01KRM156N
notes: as_of is the end of the observation month, the point at which the monthly average is complete

notes: as_of is the end of the observation month, the point at which the monthly average is complete
